status: DRAFT - not frozen until preflight_blockers are cleared, committed and tagged

study.title: Calibration Robustness of Lightweight Evidential Deep Learning under Data Augmentation and Progressive Image Degradation in Medical Image Classification
study.type: empirical interaction study; no claim of a new method or a universal winner

data.missing_image_policy: abort with a report; never silently filter

split.hash_rule: normalize CRLF to LF before hashing; abort on mismatch
required_assertions: zero lesion overlap for every partition pair
every image in exactly one partition
historical pilot validation IDs (old fold 0) fall entirely in train
split.test_set_history_note: Test images were part of pilot training sets but were never used to evaluate or select anything; they are held out from the 144-run study.

preprocessing.limitation: Direct resize distorts the 4:3 aspect ratio; documented, matches pilots

cutmix.label_weight: recomputed from the actual clipped box area

training.max_epochs_status: provisional until convergence_pilot is evaluated; one value for all 144 runs
training.resume_policy: refuse to resume if split hash, config hash or commit differ; exact bitwise resume not claimed

failure_policy: Interruption: resume same run, same seed. NaN or invalid output: record and investigate, never swap seeds. A code defect requires a protocol version bump and rerun of affected runs.

classification_probabilities.edl: q_k = alpha_k / S, S = sum_j alpha_j
classification_probabilities.r_edl: q_k = alpha_k / S, S = sum_j alpha_j

metrics.brier: mean over samples of sum_k (q_ik - y_ik)^2, not divided by K

ood.fpr95: fraction of ID at or above the threshold giving 95% OOD recall

P1_cutmix_vs_base_ece.outcome: test ECE(CutMix) - ECE(Base flips), one contrast per framework (four co-primary)
P1_cutmix_vs_base_ece.per_seed_estimate: mean over 3 backbones (3 matched pairs per framework per seed)
P1_cutmix_vs_base_ece.headline: mean and SD of the 3 seed-specific estimates
P1_cutmix_vs_base_ece.multiplicity: report all four; use 98.75% percentile intervals (Bonferroni, 4 contrasts) for this family
P1_cutmix_vs_base_ece.disclosure: framework separation and directions were informed by validation-fold pilots

P2_fedl_vs_softmax_pad_ufes20_auroc.outcome: AUROC(F-EDL native epistemic) - AUROC(Softmax MSP) on PAD-UFES-20
P2_fedl_vs_softmax_pad_ufes20_auroc.bootstrap: joint resampling of HAM10000 test lesions and PAD-UFES-20 clusters (patient_id / lesion_id)

P4_cutmix_vs_base_corruption_ece_degrada.outcome: mean over 20 corrupted conditions of (ECE_corrupt - ECE_clean), CutMix minus Base flips

statistics.seed_variation: report three seed-specific estimates, mean and SD
statistics.pilot_selection_disclosure: Core comparisons were chosen after pilot evaluation on the historical validation fold, not on the new test partition.

temperature_scaling.secondary: two-fold cross-fit inside the validation fold; no split change

split_sensitivity.method: retrain 1-2 pre-specified configs with different fold roles; do not alter the primary study

ood.aupr_note: AUROC and FPR95 do not depend on prevalence; report AUPR with prevalence, plus a fixed-seed balanced subsample as secondary

pad_ufes_20.description: domain/acquisition shift with overlapping diagnostic classes, not pure semantic OOD

cifar100.limitation: upsampled 32x32 images are blurry; far-OOD AUROC may be optimistic

corruption_study.configs: 2 backbones x 2 frameworks x 2 augmentations = 8 (efficientnet_b0, mobilenet_v3_small; softmax, f_edl; base_flips, cutmix)
corruption_study.bundles: one compressed .npz per model run (24 runs)

efficiency_benchmarks.gpu: NVIDIA Tesla T4 only; do not mix GPU models

contents: run id, seed, checkpoint id, split hash

convergence_pilot.data: train and validation only, final code, final split
convergence_pilot.extend_cap_to_60_if: any pilot has best validation macro-F1 at epoch 46 or later, or reaches epoch 50 without early stopping

chest_xray_secondary_study.status: secondary; freeze before examining HAM10000 test results
chest_xray_secondary_study.cxr_base: Resize 224x224, rotation +/-5 deg, translate up to 5%, grayscale to 3 channels, ImageNet normalize, no flips
chest_xray_secondary_study.near_ood: TB-positive images only from Shenzhen and Montgomery

decision_gate: After primary results, record 1-3 follow-up questions in protocol/followup_questions.md before running extra analyses
preflight_blockers: unit tests: q and native score per framework vs hand-computed examples
audit legacy OOD scripts against the frozen native scores
enumerate and hash the 20 corruption conditions with parameter values
freeze PAD-UFES-20 file/label manifest and hashes
measure checkpoint and prediction sizes in the smoke test
pin and verify the FLOPs tool version string
